info.title: SEC API
info.description: Independent SEC EDGAR interface for discovery, documents, source-native XML, ownership, reported facts and exports. Account quotas apply across keys. Beta document parsers have explicit bounded source scope; no normalized-statement or complete-archive guarantee.

get.summary: Query quarterly imported ownership transaction tables
get.description: Imported derivative/nonderivative transaction tables only, including amendments as filed. Separate from single-accession insider-trades. Source dates/amounts remain strings. All filters combine with AND. Pass snapshotId as snapshot on later pages. Optional facets count the same fully filtered immutable import population; every dimension sums to pagination.total.

parameters.description: Imported YYYYqN; omitted selects latest completed archive. Unavailable period returns404 dataset_not_imported.

parameters.name: cik
parameters.description: Optional issuer CIK, not reporting owner.

parameters.name: transactionCode
parameters.description: Exact source code; slash-separated value is literal, not an OR list.

parameters.name: hasFootnotes
parameters.description: Whether source row has nonblank footnote references.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Include counts for the same fully AND-filtered population, not disjunctive counts.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Expected numeric meta.snapshotId; changed import returns409 snapshot_changed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum requested transaction rows;900KB row-data budget may shorten page.
